name: module-federation-demo
description: Micro-frontend demo using Webpack 5 Module Federation with React 18, React 16, and Vue 3

scripts.predev: echo "🚀 Starting all micro-frontends... This may take 2-3 minutes on first run."
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "host,products,cart" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev:host" "npm run dev:products" "npm run dev:cart"
scripts.postdev: echo "✅ All services started! Main app: http://localhost:4000"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:products && npm run build:cart && npm run build:host
scripts.install:packages: cd packages/host && npm install && cd ../products && npm install && cd ../cart && npm install && cd ../shared && npm install

author: Paduma
